description: Source code for a TodoMVC application using Ractive.js framework, defining the main app logic, event handling, and data management.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a todo item at the specified index.

methods.name: newTodo
methods.description: Creates a new todo item with the description from input.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Enables editing mode for a specific todo item.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits the edited description for a todo item.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels editing mode for a todo item.

methods.name: toggleAll
methods.description: Toggles the completed state of all todo items.
